settings.title: Made-to-order & delivery
settings.content: Every RUGKARI rug is made to order by our Bhadohi atelier and dispatched in about 10 days. Shipping is free and insured across India, with doorstep delivery, order tracking and a GST invoice on every order.

settings.title: Warranty & returns
settings.content: Every rug is 100% handmade and backed by a 10-year warranty against manufacturing defects. Not right for your room? Return it within 15 days of delivery. Our care team at care@rugkari.com will help with either.

settings.title: Certificate of authenticity
settings.content: Each rug ships with a signed, numbered Certificate of Authenticity, hand-finished, rolled in cotton cloth and delivered insured to your door.

settings.title: Drawn on cloth
settings.text: The design is drawn full size on a cotton cloth stretched on a frame.

settings.title: Tufted by hand
settings.text: Karigars punch wool through the cloth, loop by loop, following the drawing.

settings.title: Backed & sheared
settings.text: A cotton backing locks the pile, which is then sheared level by hand.

settings.title: Washed & inspected
settings.text: Washed, checked, rolled in cloth and sent insured to your door.
